subject: integration
name: Ether price standard (ETH_PRICE_0_1)
summary: Defines one read: the price of ether in a fiat currency, answered as a decimal string with the time taken and how many independent sources agreed. A provider with several sources moves on after 5 seconds and takes the median; a single on-chain feed answers as 1 source and refuses an update over 2 hours old. The call carries only the currency. Nothing here checks the price or the source count, and the limits are marked provisional. The row connects to nothing. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
